title: @T1scale
description: Fix bias field shading in T1 by scaling it with PD image. You can also get a decent result even without the PD volume.

output_directory.description: Directory where output gets dumped. Default is T1scale/
output_directory.title: Output Directory

align.description: Align PD volume to T1. Without this option, PDvol is assumed in alignment with T1vol.
align.title: Align PD with T1

mask.description: Create mask for the output. If not specified, the script will generate one with 3dAutomask on fattened PDvol.
mask.title: Mask Volume

unmasked_uni.description: Do not apply masking to uniformized volume (default)
unmasked_uni.title: Unmasked Uniformized Volume

help.description: Display this help message and exit
help.title: Help Flag

h_web.description: Open webpage with help for this program
h_web.title: Web Help

h_view.description: Open -help output in a GUI editor
h_view.title: Open Help in GUI

all_opts.description: List all of the options for this script
all_opts.title: List All Options

h_find_word.description: Search for lines containing WORD in -help output. Search is approximate.
h_find_word.title: Find Word in Help
